phase: P0-E: cancellation-versus-accepted-Send receipt race in same-tab recovery
defect: An accepted same-tab or fallback Send could be reported as cancelled if cancel() raced the delayed accepted acknowledgement. The cancellation result hid an already committed send receipt; a later recovery must still be forbidden.

changes.accepted_delta: Return resumed and restore RESUMED even if cancellation was requested while submit() awaited acknowledgement.
changes.accepted_fallback: Return fallback and restore FALLBACK_SUBMITTED when accepted acknowledgement races cancellation.
changes.unknown_receipt: Keep UNKNOWN_STOP_OR_SEND unsafe; never infer acceptance from cancellation.
changes.no_replay: Sticky cancelled flag rejects all later recover() attempts, including after accepted receipts.

red.failure: Both accepted-after-cancellation tests expected resumed/fallback but received cancelled.

green.environment: Bun 1.4.0 on Windows, local deterministic fixtures

acceptance_limits.actual_owned_browser_recovery: NOT RUN: no live browser Send or Stop performed
acceptance_limits.dom_tests: 3 SKIP: headless / real owned DOM gates remain unverified
acceptance_limits.native_web_accepted_receipt: NOT RUN: mocked action acknowledgements only
acceptance_limits.full_goal: PARTIAL: broader ENV/REPLAY/COMPACT and all other GOAL requirements still require independent acceptance
